primary_endpoint: Change in MRI-PDFF from baseline to Week 14 (end of treatment, day 92).
efficacy_outcome: MRI-PDFF change: −1.25 with leronlimab 700 mg, −0.90 with 350 mg, and +0.90 with placebo; no statistical comparison reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 2/30 with leronlimab 700 mg, 1/27 with 350 mg (including 1 death), and 2/30 with placebo; no deaths in the other groups.
